what: The pill button is pulled toward the cursor by 32% of its distance from center over .6s power3.out, while the inner text is pulled only 18%, creating layers. When the pointer leaves, it springs back with a .9s elastic (elastic.out(1, .4)) and settles in place. The entry and exit points are kept as --fx-x·--fx-y so the fill circle spreads from that spot

options.label: Text drag ratio, default .18 — at 0 the text moves only together with the button
options.ease: Drag curve in the form (0.16,1,0.3,1), default power3.out
options.spring: Returning GSAP curve, default elastic.out(1, 0.4) — with none it returns over the same length and curve as the drag
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Inner text that is pulled less (optional)
options.ring: Surrounding circle child ([data-fx-part=ring]) pull ratio, default 0 — for pulling only the circle while leaving the button (Brand uses pull 0 · ring .6 · label .4)
options.pull-y: Vertical drag ratio, defaults to the same as pull
options.spin: Rotation angle in degrees per px dragged horizontally, default 0 — Brand uses 1/3 (horizontal drag ÷ 3 degrees)
options.label-ease: Letter drag curve (GSAP name or a form like 0.4,1.05,0.6,1), same as the default ease
options.tilt: Max tilt angle (degrees) by horizontal distance from the panel’s half-width (−1 to 1), default 0 — Brand text card 1 (pull .05 · .15s power2.out · on release .5s power2.out)
options.mode: edge — pull is given not as a distance ratio from the center but as a −1~1 position relative to the panel edge × rem (pull·label·dot in rem). Default is the distance ratio
options.dot: In edge type, [data-fx-part=dot] (dots beside the button) pull (rem), default 0
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Small dot dragged separately (multiple allowed, optional)
